newsitem.title: UK: Brands Hatch Leisure seeks stock exchange listing.
newsitem.headline: Brands Hatch Leisure seeks stock exchange listing.

text.p: Brands Hatch Leisure Plc is to seek a quotation on the Official List of the London Stock Exchange by means of a placing sponsored by Beeson Gregory, the company said on Monday.
Brands Hatch organises and promotes motorsport and has four motorsport circuits at Brands Hatch in Kent, Cadwell Park in Lincolnshire, Oulton Park in Cheshire and Snetterton in Norfolk.
It promotes some 150 events a year including the world superbike championship and British formula two and three events.
The flotation is expected to raise 8.0 million stg, which will be used to reduce borrowing and raise investment capital.
"A listing on the London Stock Exchange will allow us to raise significant capital for further investment in our expanding leisure activities," said chief executive Nicola Foulston.
"We also welcome the prospect of extending share ownership to employees and enthusiasts of motor sport as well as traditional institutional investors."
